prompt: Challenge C061-CH1: Our cold-pressed pumpkin seed oil goes rancid within 4 months on shelf, but competitors manage 9–12 months; we lose about 15% of each batch

content.text: {"claims":[{"claim":1,"text":"Research on cold-pressed seed oils demonstrates that nitrogen flushing significantly reduced peroxide value at day 30 and suppressed chlorophyll-mediated photosensitised oxidation, with headspace oxygen residual levels above 2% identified as a maximum threshold for small-scale operations.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-02921","field":"abstract","quote":"Nitrogen flushing significantly reduced PV at day 30 (3.2 vs. 9.7 meq O₂/kg, p < 0.001) and suppressed chlorophyll-mediated photosensitised oxidation"}]},{"claim":2,"text":"Research on cold-pressed oils including pumpkin shows that activated bleaching earth treatment at 2% reduced initial peroxide value by 38–55% across oil types, confirming adsorption of polar hydroperoxides, but simultaneously caused a 12–29% loss of total tocopherols.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-02924","field":"abstract","quote":"ABE treatment at 2% reduced initial PV by 38–55% across oil types, confirming its known adsorption of polar hydroperoxides, but simultaneously caused a 12–29% loss of total tocopherols"}]}]}
